message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Liu X X suspected of embezzlement but insufficient evidence. However, during investigation, Liu colluded with others to fabricate false facts, instructed a witness to change testimony, and gave false statements to investigators. This is obstruction of justice, i.e., "妨害作证" (obstructing testimony) or "妨害公务"? The list includes "妨害作证" (obstructing testimony) and "妨害公务" (obstructing public duties). The description: He instructed witness to give false testimony, and gave false statements to investigators, which is making false statements to judicial authorities, i.e., "妨害作证". The list also includes "妨害作证". So the charge is 妨害作证.

Check if any other charge: Possibly "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章"? No. "妨害作证" is correct.

Thus answer: [罪名]妨害作证<eoa>
